reviews.comment: Her enthusiasm for finance is clear; her lack of experience in the classroom is painfully obvious. She lectures to the whiteboard and not the class and questions are often not answered very well. Be prepared to teach yourself most of the material after class. 2 tests worth 75% of your grade and a few HW to help. She's very nice but can't teach.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things
